title: Count the number of characters in a file
summary: Use the wc command to count characters in a text file, correctly handling multi-byte characters like emojis or accented letters.

steps.explain: Run wc with the --chars flag followed by the path to your file. This counts characters, treating multi-byte sequences as single characters.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the text file you want to count characters in

alternatives.explain: Use the short flag -m instead of --chars.
